decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits close to the core heat exchange portfolio and serves process and energy customers, so keeping it costs little and fits the efficiency strategy.
Air cooled condensers are a standard offering for power and refrigeration customers, and this one aligns with the firm's established manufacturing base.
This second single-tube condenser variant overlaps with Product B and could be consolidated, but a growing, expanding firm will most likely keep both variants for different applications.
Liners for corroded tubes support the lifecycle service and repair business, which is high-margin and central to the firm's service strategy.
A customized industrial air cooler line with several models fits the firm's integrated, customized solutions approach and serves a broad customer base.
Tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair offering, extending equipment life with low ongoing resource needs.
